people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him, and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
translations.bsb: But our fathers refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.
translations.kjv: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
translations.asv: to whom our fathers would not be obedient, but thrust him from them, and turned back in their hearts unto Egypt,
